lines.text: Carrying His own cross, Jesus goes to Golgotha, where they crucify Him between two others.
Pilate posts a notice reading "The King of the Jews" in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek, and many read it.
The chief priests ask Pilate to change the sign, and Pilate agrees to rewrite it.

wrong_details.true: Pilate refuses, saying "What I have written, I have written."

lines.text: The soldiers divide His garments into three parts and cast lots for the seamless tunic.

wrong_details.true: four parts, one for each soldier

lines.text: Jesus gives His mother to the disciple whom He loved, says "I am thirsty," receives sour wine on hyssop, and says "It is finished."
